name: refi.finance
rootCause: Weibo user “CryptoBlanker” broke the news: the refi.finance project party directly used the reserved setBoardroom() function to change the Boardroom address to the address it deployed. Light BAS was taken away 2,600, worth 111 ETH (about 144,000 US dollars).
